parameters.name: Channel
parameters.description: {{reference}}This is the channel that is being bonded. This is read-only because bonding is expected to be configured by the CPE, not by the Controller.

object.description: DSL bonded channel table. Each table entry represents a bonded channel within the bonding group, and is associated with exactly one {{object|##.Channel}} instance or one {{object|###.FAST.Line}} instance. There MUST be an instance of {{object}} for each DSL channel or FAST line that is bonded. When a {{object|##.Channel}} or {{object|###.FAST.Line}} is no longer bonded, then the CPE MUST delete the corresponding {{object}} instance. However, when a bonded {{object|##.Channel}} or {{object|###.FAST.Line}} becomes disabled, the channel remains bonded and so the corresponding {{object}} instance MUST NOT be deleted.
